map.💡 脏腑辨证是内伤杂病辨证的核心。临床须辨明病位（何脏何腑）与病性（虚实寒热），: 💡 Zang-fu differentiation is the core of differentiating internal injury and miscellaneous diseases. Clinically one must identify the disease location (which zang, which fu) and the disease nature (deficiency, excess, cold, heat), combining them into a complete pattern name such as "heart qi deficiency" or "liver yang rising".
